intent: the store profile: country, currency and whether the subscription carries VAT (the dashboard call)
js: (async () => { const h = {"accept": "application/json", "content-type": "application/json", "accept-language": "en", "role": localStorage.getItem("role"), "store-id": localStorage.getItem("storeId"), "x-manager-token": localStorage.getItem("_t")}; const r = await fetch("https://hermod.zid.sa/v1/managers/account/profile", {method: "GET", headers: h, credentials: "include"}); const j = await r.json(); const s = j.user.store; return {status: r.status, country: j.user.business_location && j.user.business_location.country && j.user.business_location.country.code, currency: s.currency && s.currency.code, is_vat_required_in_subscription: s.is_vat_required_in_subscription, subscription_payment_methods: s.subscription_payment_methods, package: s.subscription && s.subscription.package_code}; })()
